summary: A stdio MCP server on Effect, serving typed tools and a resource over JSON-RPC to agent clients.
description: Build a stdio MCP server with Effect's MCP modules: declare typed tools, register a resource, and speak newline-delimited JSON-RPC over stdin and stdout. Vitest covers the pure parts; an e2e test does a real client handshake against the built server. The proving slice is a ping tool, an echo tool and one markdown resource, extended after the handshake passes.
seoDescription: A stdio MCP server on Effect with typed tools, a resource, JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout and a real client handshake test.

projectExamples.title: Internal script tool server
projectExamples.description: Illustrative: expose selected team scripts as typed tools an assistant can call. Add the script integration and its access rules after the ping, echo and resource checks pass.

plain.whatItIs: A starter MCP server: a program that lets AI assistants call your tools and read documents through a shared protocol.
goodAt: Giving assistants typed tools they can run as a local subprocess
Testing tool calls and document reads against the built program
notGoodAt: MCP features Effect lacks; use the official TypeScript MCP SDK instead.
Chat screens or model calls; choose a web app with a model provider.
